summary: First full-stack test iteration for SIM MI Miftahul Jannah. Created pytest regression suite (44 tests) covering auth, dashboards/portal, students/teachers/classes/subjects/users CRUD, kiosk (public) scan flow, attendance list/recap, ledger grade formula, class-meta, and savings. All 44 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend Playwright verified: admin/guru/siswa login redirects to /dashboard, admin dashboard renders stat cards and Recharts charts, sidebar shows correct role groups, kiosk /kiosk is public with keypad + submit and returns 'NISN / Kartu Tidak Ditemukan!' for invalid code, role isolation OK (siswa hitting /siswa admin route is redirected).

minor.issue: Lockout uses login_attempts.locked_until only when count>=5, but count is incremented on every failure without a rolling window — a user could be locked after 5 wrong attempts over any timespan and reset only after 15 minutes from the LAST failed attempt (locked_until keeps sliding). Not blocking but worth reviewing.
Guard only checks role=admin at time of call. Works, but there's no protection against admin deleting their own account when another admin exists — acceptable per spec.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py brute-force lockout window is sliding (locked_until is overwritten on every failed attempt); consider a fixed window or resetting count after cooldown.
routes_dashboard.admin_dashboard iterates over ALL students calling get_balance() → O(N*M) full savings scan for each student; will not scale. Aggregate with a single $group query.
routes_savings.get_balance recomputes from scratch each call — same performance concern; consider caching balance per student.

auth.py get_current_user reads token from cookie 'access_token' but /login does NOT set a cookie (only returns token in body). Cookie code path is dead; either drop it or set the cookie for defense in depth.
No pagination limit cap on list endpoints (to_list(1000-2000)); large datasets will bloat responses.
